description.en:
Basic Attack

Yinlin controls the puppet "Zapstring" to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring", dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring" to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Yinlin mengendalikan boneka "Zapstring" untuk melakukan hingga 4 serangan, memberikan Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Yinlin mengonsumsi STA untuk mengendalikan "Zapstring", memberikan Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Yinlin mengonsumsi STA untuk mengendalikan "Zapstring" melakukan Plunging Attack di udara, memberikan Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.

description.en:
Magnetic Roar

The puppet "Zapstring" deals Electro DMG to the target, and puts Yinlin in Resonance Skill Execution Mode.

Execution Mode

Basic Attack and Dodge Counter will trigger 1 Electromagnetic Blast when hitting a target.
Each stage of Basic Attack or Dodge Counter can only trigger 1 Electromagnetic Blast, up to 4 times.

Electromagnetic Blast

Attack all targets marked with Forte Circuit Sinner's Mark, dealing Electro DMG.

Lightning Execution

Use Resonance Skill after casting Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar to cast Lightning Execution to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
If Resonance Skill Lightning Execution is not activated in a while or this Character is switched, this Skill will be put on Cooldown.
description.id:
Magnetic Roar

Boneka "Zapstring" memberikan Electro DMG ke target, dan membuat Yinlin memasuki Resonance Skill Execution Mode.

Execution Mode

Basic Attack dan Dodge Counter akan memicu 1 Electromagnetic Blast saat mengenai target.
Setiap tahap Basic Attack atau Dodge Counter hanya dapat memicu 1 Electromagnetic Blast, hingga 4 kali.

Electromagnetic Blast

Menyerang semua target yang ditandai dengan Forte Circuit Sinner's Mark, memberikan Electro DMG.

Lightning Execution

Gunakan Resonance Skill setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar untuk melancarkan Lightning Execution menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.
Jika Resonance Skill Lightning Execution tidak diaktifkan dalam beberapa saat atau karakter ini diganti, skill ini akan memasuki Cooldown.

description.en: Command "Zapstring" to call for thunder to fall upon a large range, dealing Electro DMG.
description.id: Memerintahkan "Zapstring" memanggil petir untuk menyambar area luas, memberikan Electro DMG.

description.en: After using Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar, Yinlin's Crit. Rate is increased by 15% for 5s.
description.id: Setelah menggunakan Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar, Crit. Rate Yinlin meningkat sebesar 15% selama 5 dtk.

description.en: The damage of Resonance Skill Lightning Execution is increased by 10% when hitting targets marked with Sinner's Mark, and Yinlin's ATK is increased by 10% for 4s when this is triggered.
description.id: Damage Resonance Skill Lightning Execution meningkat sebesar 10% saat mengenai target yang ditandai Sinner's Mark, dan ATK Yinlin meningkat sebesar 10% selama 4 dtk saat ini terpicu.

description.en: Command puppet "Zapstring" to attack, dealing Electro DMG in a large range.
description.id: Memerintahkan boneka "Zapstring" untuk menyerang, memberikan Electro DMG di area luas.

description.en:
Chameleon Cipher

When Yinlin's Judgment Points are full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with Chameleon Cipher, which consumes all Judgment Points to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG. When it hits a target marked with Sinner's Mark, the Sinner's Mark is replaced with Punishment Mark, lasting for 18s. Chameleon Cipher deals Heavy Attack DMG.

Sinner's Mark

Basic Attack Zapstring's Dance, Resonance Liberation Thundering Wrath, and Intro Skill Roaring Storm apply Sinner's Mark to the target on hit.
Sinner's Mark is removed when Yinlin is switched out.

Punishment Mark

When a target marked with Punishment Mark takes damage, Judgement Strike will fall, triggering Coordinated Attacks to all targets marked with Punishment Mark, dealing Electro DMG. This can be triggered up to 1 time per second. Judgement Strike deals Resonance Skill DMG.

Judgment Points

Yinlin can hold up to 100 Judgement Points. Yinlin gains Judgement Points through the following ways:
Upon casting Intro Skill Raging Storm
When Basic Attack Zapstring's Dance hits a target
Upon casting Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar;
When Resonance Skill Electromagnetic Blast hits a target;
Upon casting Resonance Skill Lightning Execution.
description.id:
Chameleon Cipher

Saat Judgment Points Yinlin penuh, Heavy Attack-nya digantikan oleh Chameleon Cipher, yang mengonsumsi seluruh Judgment Points untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG. Saat mengenai target yang ditandai Sinner's Mark, Sinner's Mark diganti dengan Punishment Mark, bertahan selama 18 dtk. Chameleon Cipher memberikan Heavy Attack DMG.

Sinner's Mark

Basic Attack Zapstring's Dance, Resonance Liberation Thundering Wrath, dan Intro Skill Roaring Storm menimpakan Sinner's Mark pada target saat mengenai.
Sinner's Mark dihapus saat Yinlin diganti keluar.

Punishment Mark

Saat target yang ditandai Punishment Mark menerima damage, Judgement Strike akan jatuh, memicu Coordinated Attack ke semua target yang ditandai Punishment Mark, memberikan Electro DMG. Ini dapat terpicu hingga 1 kali per detik. Judgement Strike memberikan Resonance Skill DMG.

Judgment Points

Yinlin dapat menyimpan hingga 100 Judgement Points. Yinlin mendapat Judgement Points melalui cara berikut:
Saat melancarkan Intro Skill Raging Storm
Saat Basic Attack Zapstring's Dance mengenai target
Saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar;
Saat Resonance Skill Electromagnetic Blast mengenai target;
Saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Lightning Execution.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Memiliki peluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: The incoming Resonator has their Electro DMG Amplified by 20% and Resonance Liberation DMG Amplified by 25% for 14s or until they are switched out.
description.id: Resonator yang masuk mendapat Amplify Electro DMG sebesar 20% dan Amplify Resonance Liberation DMG sebesar 25% selama 14 dtk atau hingga diganti keluar.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar and Lightning Execution deal 70% more DMG.
description.id: Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar dan Lightning Execution memberikan 70% lebih banyak DMG.

description.en: Resonance Skill Electromagnetic Blast recovers an additional 5 Judgement Point(s) and 5 Resonance Energy on hit.
description.id: Resonance Skill Electromagnetic Blast memulihkan tambahan 5 Judgement Point dan 5 Resonance Energy saat mengenai target.

description.en: Forte Circuit Judgment Strike's DMG multiplier is increased by 55%.
description.id: Pengali DMG Forte Circuit Judgment Strike meningkat sebesar 55%.

description.en: When Forte Circuit Judgment Strike hits a target, the ATK of all team members is increased by 20% for 12s.
description.id: Saat Forte Circuit Judgment Strike mengenai target, ATK semua anggota tim meningkat sebesar 20% selama 12 dtk.

description.en: Resonance Liberation Thundering Wrath deals 100% extra DMG to targets with Forte Circuit's Sinner's Mark or Punishment Mark.
description.id: Resonance Liberation Thundering Wrath memberikan 100% DMG tambahan ke target dengan Forte Circuit Sinner's Mark atau Punishment Mark.

description.en: In the first 30s after casting Resonance Liberation Thundering Wrath, when Yinlin's Basic Attack hits a target, Furious Thunder will be triggered, dealing Electro DMG equal to 419.59% of Yinlin's ATK. Every Basic Attack hit can trigger Furious Thunder 1 time, up to 4 times. This is considered Resonance Skill DMG.
description.id: Dalam 30 dtk pertama setelah melancarkan Resonance Liberation Thundering Wrath, saat Basic Attack Yinlin mengenai target, Furious Thunder akan terpicu, memberikan Electro DMG sebesar 419,59% ATK Yinlin. Setiap hit Basic Attack dapat memicu Furious Thunder 1 kali, hingga 4 kali. Ini dianggap Resonance Skill DMG.
